original_ai_prompt: Split our office into three networks: staff computers, the printers, and a visitor network. Staff and printers need to reach each other so people can print; visitors should be kept on their own network. DHCP for everyone. DSL internet.
cleaned_prompt: Split our office into three networks: staff computers, the printers, and a visitor network. Staff and printers need to reach each other so people can print; visitors should be kept on their own network. DHCP for everyone. DSL internet.

requirements.statement: Staff and printers are on separate networks but can reach each other
Visitors are on their own network

expected_behaviour: Three VLANs; staff<->printer reachability is stated as reachable (not an isolation guarantee), visitor segment is separate but WITHOUT an 'internet-only' isolation claim, so it builds.
capability_limitations: Three VLANs; staff<->printer reachability is stated as reachable (not an isolation guarantee), visitor segment is separate but WITHOUT an 'internet-only' isolation claim, so it builds.
why_suitable: Carefully worded to stay on the buildable side of the guest-isolation boundary — contrasts with the refusal cases. Tests precision about what 'kept on their own network' does and doesn't promise.
